front.title: Disclosure of Negative Trust Anchors in DNS Responses

abstract.t:
This document describes a mechanism for disclosing that a Negative Trust Anchor (NTA) was in effect at the time that a DNS response was generated, using an Extended DNS Error (EDE).
Discussion Venues
This note is to be removed before publishing as an RFC.
Discussion of this document takes place on the Domain Name System Operations Working Group mailing list (dnsop@ietf.org), which is archived at https://mailarchive.ietf.org/arch/browse/dnsop/.
Source for this draft and an issue tracker can be found at https://github.com/ietf-wg-dnsop/draft-ietf-dnsop-ede-nta.
